text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E and Stock A after gains did not protect the portfolio from later declines; I should base trades on future risk and return, not the satisfaction of locking in a gain.","Avoiding trades through several down periods is not automatically discipline; I should review holdings against my investment rationale without letting loss aversion keep me invested.","Monthly price moves are noisy and do not predict what comes next, so I should stay diversified and trade only when my assessment changes."]}
